title: Comprehensive Guide to Deceased Estates & Succession Planning
excerpt: Protecting family legacies and assets requires proactive estate planning. Learn about wills, trust registrations, and estate administration in Zimbabwe.
body:
Estate planning is one of the most critical legal steps individuals can take to protect their family's wealth and ensure seamless asset distribution upon death. In Zimbabwe, administering a deceased estate involves specific statutory procedures under the Administration of Estates Act.

Creating a valid, legal will ensures that an individual's wishes regarding real estate, investments, and personal belongings are executed smoothly without unnecessary probate delays or family disputes. Without a valid will, estates are administered in accordance with intestate succession laws, which may not align with personal preferences.

Additionally, family trust registration provides an effective legal framework for preserving generational wealth, offering asset protection and favorable estate duty management. Mavula & Co. Law Chambers assists families in navigating these legal instruments with utmost diligence and care.
author: Thuto Mavula
